value.rationale: The qualitative phase boundary separates bath-mediated positive cycle-work persistence from negative one-step measurement-error memory, and proves sign positivity at all longer lags. It is a physically natural reliability observable for cyclic information engines beyond known mean-work/power studies; the boundary distinguishes long- and short-memory active baths without claiming a total-entropy-production result.
